items.docs: Returns a list of all webhooks configured for the specified project. Each webhook entry includes its URL, enabled event triggers, and SSL verification settings.

info.name: GitLab Add a Webhook to a Project

params.name: id
params.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project. For example, 42 or namespace%2Fproject-name.

items.docs: Creates a new webhook for the specified project. The webhook will receive HTTP POST requests for the configured event triggers. A secret token can be specified for payload verification.

params.name: id
params.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project. For example, 42 or namespace%2Fproject-name.

params.name: hook_id
params.description: The ID of the webhook.

items.docs: Returns configuration details for a specific webhook in a project, including the URL, enabled triggers, and SSL verification setting.

params.name: id
params.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project. For example, 42 or namespace%2Fproject-name.

params.name: hook_id
params.description: The ID of the webhook.

items.docs: Modifies the configuration of an existing project webhook. You can update the URL, secret token, SSL verification setting, and which events trigger the webhook.

params.name: id
params.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project. For example, 42 or namespace%2Fproject-name.

params.name: hook_id
params.description: The ID of the webhook.

items.docs: Removes a webhook from the specified project. Deleted webhooks will no longer receive event deliveries.

params.name: id
params.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project. For example, 42 or namespace%2Fproject-name.

params.name: hook_id
params.description: The ID of the webhook.

items.docs: Returns a list of all delivery events for a specified project webhook from the past 7 days. Each event includes the trigger type, response status code, request and response headers, and payload body.

params.name: id
params.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project. For example, 42 or namespace%2Fproject-name.

params.name: hook_id
params.description: The ID of the webhook.

params.name: hook_event_id
params.description: The ID of the webhook event to resend.

items.docs: Resends a previously triggered webhook event to the configured URL. Useful for retrying failed deliveries or for debugging webhook configurations.

params.name: id
params.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project. For example, 42 or namespace%2Fproject-name.

params.name: hook_id
params.description: The ID of the webhook.

params.name: trigger
params.description: The event type to simulate. Supported values include push_events, tag_push_events, issues_events, confidential_issues_events, note_events, merge_requests_events, job_events, pipeline_events, wiki_page_events, releases_events, and member_events.

items.docs: Sends a test webhook payload of the specified trigger type to the configured webhook URL. Use this to verify the webhook endpoint is reachable and handling payloads correctly.

info.name: GitLab Set a Webhook Custom Header

params.name: id
params.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project. For example, 42 or namespace%2Fproject-name.

params.name: hook_id
params.description: The ID of the webhook.

params.name: key
params.description: The name of the custom header.

items.docs: Adds or updates a custom HTTP header sent with every webhook delivery for the specified webhook. Custom headers are useful for authentication or routing at the receiving endpoint.

info.name: GitLab Delete a Webhook Custom Header

params.name: id
params.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project. For example, 42 or namespace%2Fproject-name.

params.name: hook_id
params.description: The ID of the webhook.

params.name: key
params.description: The name of the custom header to delete.

items.docs: Removes a custom HTTP header from the specified webhook. The header will no longer be included in future webhook deliveries.

info.name: GitLab Set a Webhook URL Variable

params.name: id
params.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project. For example, 42 or namespace%2Fproject-name.

params.name: hook_id
params.description: The ID of the webhook.

params.name: key
params.description: The name of the URL variable.

items.docs: Adds or updates a URL variable for the specified webhook. URL variables allow dynamic substitution in the webhook URL, enabling reuse of the same webhook configuration with different target endpoints.

info.name: GitLab Delete a Webhook URL Variable

params.name: id
params.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project. For example, 42 or namespace%2Fproject-name.

params.name: hook_id
params.description: The ID of the webhook.

params.name: key
params.description: The name of the URL variable to delete.

items.docs: Removes a URL variable from the specified webhook. The variable will no longer be substituted in future webhook deliveries.
